mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of months where UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS occurs in more than 30% of periods but is followed by positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 98.0) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth potential, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE occurs in more than 25% of periods but is followed by positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 850) signals residential construction boom that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 850.
